# hammer-first-map-starter-templates — fixtures

Starter templates + onboarding checklist data (Source 2 speed). Backend /
data-model / API only, zero UI code. Implementation:
`kernel/Effigy/Map/StarterTemplates.cs`; tests: `tests/StarterTemplatesTests.cs`
(group `startertemplates`).

## Templates (all validate clean under IssueEngine; all pass their checklist)

| id | shape |
|---|---|
| `minimal-room` | Sealed 512x512 room, 256 high: 6 brushes + `info_player_start` + `light` + 2D skybox `sky_day01_01`. |
| `surf-ramp` | Sealed 1024x512 room + a wedge surf ramp (256x256x128) against the -X wall; spawn faces the ramp. |
| `outdoor-displacement` | Sealed 1024x1024 yard, power-3 displacement on the ground top face, `light_environment` sun, `sky_camera` + 16x 3D skybox section (3 mountain brushes), skybox-textured lid seal. |

## Files

- `minimal-room.vmf` — golden VMF text of `StarterTemplates.MinimalRoom()`,
  generated by the builder itself. The test asserts the builder's current VMF
  text is byte-identical to this file: if the builder changes, regenerate the
  fixture from the builder (standalone harness, see below) — never edit it by hand.
- `minimal-room.expected.json` — counts the fixture must match (6 brushes,
  36 faces, 2 entities, skybox `sky_day01_01`, checklist passes).
- `checklist-light-removed.expected.json` — checklist result for the minimal
  room with its `light` removed: only `light` and `playtest` fail, first
  incomplete step is `light`.

## How the fixture was generated / verified

The full Desktop test tree does not compile while sibling hammer workers'
in-progress files are unlanded/broken (no `MapBrush.cs` yet, so
`MapBrushPrimitives.cs` cannot compile; `MapDocument.cs` / `MapEntities.cs`
not on disk). Verification therefore runs in a standalone harness that
compiles only the landed files this ticket depends on
(`Vec.cs`, `GeometryLinter.cs`, `IssueEngine.cs`, `VmfIo.cs`,
`StarterTemplates.cs`) plus a small `Program.cs` mirroring every check in
`StarterTemplatesTests.cs` (16 checks) and then registering + running the REAL
`StarterTemplatesTests.cs` itself against minimal `TestRegistry` /
`TestSettings` stand-ins (another 16 checks, 32 total):

```
dotnet run --project /tmp/startercheck/startercheck.csproj -c Release
```

That harness also writes `minimal-room.vmf` into this directory. The full-tree
named-group run (`dotnet run --project tests/Desktop.Tests.csproj -c Release
-- --filter startertemplates`, with the one temporary `TestRegistry.cs`
Register line) is deferred to the final integration gate.
